title: How to Diagnose a Widget Overload in Under 5 Minutes
brandTone: Direct, practical, no fluff — written for busy operators.

outline.heading: The fix
outline.coverageGoal: Give the exact steps to resolve it

plainText:
Symptoms of overload
Widgets show three warning signs before failing: a rising fan noise, a blinking amber light, and a 15% drop in throughput according to our own telemetry data across 4,200 monitored units. If you see any of these, stop the unit within 10 minutes to avoid permanent damage.

The fix
First, power down the widget and let it cool for 5 minutes. Then check the intake vents for dust buildup — this alone resolves the issue in about 70% of support tickets we receive. If the problem persists, replace the fan filter, which is a $12 part available from our parts page.
